summary: The agent implements a functionally robust pipeline with no data leakage and a sound validation split, but it falls short in data preparation and optimization. It bypasses explicit missing value imputation, skips all feature engineering, aggregates ensemble predictions naively, and performs a single validation run instead of cross-validation. Furthermore, loop-based DataFrame assignments introduce memory fragmentation.
